description: Add a list of companies the person gave you, up to 100 rows, to one of their StockLens portfolios, in two calls. First call with confirm false: nothing is added and every row returns its outcome. Relay summary_line and message, then every row that is not a plain add, grouped by outcome, and name the plain adds in one line; name the portfolio only when portfolio_count is above 1. Ask which rows to add. Then call with confirm true, the preview_id, the same rows, the same portfolio and the confirmed_indexes the person approved. Send only rows the person gave you. For an ambiguous row, ask which listing using its candidates; never pick one. Add a not_covered row only if the person asks for it. A changed list or a different portfolio needs a new preview; preview_mismatch means the preview expired or no longer matches, so preview again. Without portfolio_id or portfolio_name it uses the default portfolio. It does not trade, record holdings or move money.

confirm.description: false previews the list and adds nothing. true adds the rows of confirmed_indexes from the preview that preview_id names.

confirmed_indexes.description: The index of every row the person approved, from the preview. Required when confirm is true.

portfolio_id.description: The id of the portfolio to add to, as get_portfolio_insights lists it. Optional: without it or portfolio_name the list goes to the default portfolio.

portfolio_name.description: The name of the portfolio to add to, as the person names it (exact, case does not matter). Optional.

preview_id.description: The preview_id the preview returned. Required when confirm is true.

rows.description: The companies the person gave you, one per row, in their order. Never add a row they did not name.

query.description: One company as the person wrote it: a ticker (AAPL), a listing (SHOP.TO) or a company name.

name: add_to_watchlist_batch
title: Add Several to Portfolio
